title: SQLite Domain Storage Convergence
invariants: SQLite becomes authoritative one domain at a time; a global backend flag never implies unimplemented authority.
Every authoritative mutation is committed to SQLite before any compatibility shadow is attempted.
Dual JSON shadows are serialized, failure-visible, closeable, and fully drained before SQLite closes.
Goal terminal, acceptance certificate, Plan lineage, checkpoint, ledger, and Kernel run_end ordering remain unchanged.
Memory session isolation, reviewed learning, embedding compatibility, and deterministic ranking remain unchanged.
Migration and rollback compare canonical records by identity and never overwrite a newer authority with a stale generation.

fileBackedExclusions.reason: Electron safeStorage ciphertext and optimistic revision semantics remain a dedicated local settings boundary.
Large scoped result blobs remain atomic file pairs; SQLite stores may index metadata only in a future program.
The append-only file ledger remains compatibility evidence until a measured production pressure or product query requires a dedicated schema.
Raw history remains an append-only redacted JSONL evidence log and is not part of the core authority cutover.
User deliverables remain files; only provenance metadata may be indexed independently.
